Self-hosted third-party scripts for the SealKeeper website
==========================================================

Served from /vendor/ so the site's Content-Security-Policy can keep
script-src to 'self' (see design/_headers). File names carry the exact
version, which makes them safe to cache as immutable. To upgrade: npm pack
the new version, check its registry integrity, copy the file under a new
versioned name, update the three governance pages (code-of-conduct,
contributing, security) and the hashes below.

marked 13.0.3 (MIT, LICENSE-marked.txt)
  source   npm marked@13.0.3, file marked.min.js
  npm      sha512-rqRix3/TWzE9rIoFGIn8JmsVfhiuC8VIQ8IdX5TfzmeBucdY05/0UlzKaw0eVtpcN/OdVFpBk7CjKGo9iHJ/zA==
  sha256   5adea7d8ee41a700fccc14bb9d503104f0470cc17a84ad3e167d3f5251eae0da  marked-13.0.3.min.js

mermaid 11.17.2 (MIT, LICENSE-mermaid.txt)
  source   npm mermaid@11.17.2, file dist/mermaid.min.js
  npm      sha512-V6K3C8EBdEsPFZXSKMJe6ppQOENxuHARr9GvHX4hh47lAbhMRD9qf4oEK7LoaRQxULMa80/qt5gHO73aCleBBg==
  sha256   581ed7d74bd9048d0e3a91363927d72ef22942d7722546b27f7cc29e35390eb8  mermaid-11.17.2.min.js

Verify: (cd design/vendor && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS)
